column1: # Every assertion the booted-server tests made before the rig was made fast, one per line,
# read out of the base commit. Speeding a suite up by asserting less is the one failure mode
# this phase had, and a line that disappears from here is what that looks like. Adding an
# assertion is fine; changing or dropping one listed here is not.
